answer: Each submission hangs on the gale of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. What survives to the terrace is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
